conflicts.rule: Do not take within 2 hours of each other. Calcium inhibits iron absorption.
High doses of Zinc deplete Copper. Take separately or supplement Copper if taking >30mg Zinc.
Vitamin D requires Magnesium for activation. Synergistic pairing, take together.

drug_interactions.rule: May stimulate immune system. Additive sedative effects with benzos. May increase T3/T4 synthesis.
CYP3A4 inducer. Will drastically reduce efficacy of birth control. Risk of serotonin syndrome with SSRIs.

timing.rule_fat_soluble: Must be taken with a meal containing dietary fat.
